descriptive_title: Grade 1 Mathematics: Algebra (Coding) — Sequential Events and Loops Without Screens (C3.1–C3.2)
short_description: A 5-day Ontario Grade-1 unit on coding without screens (C3.1-C3.2) framed around 'Loop the Loop' — Coda the Coding Robot and Looper the Loop Helper. Sequential code, loops, code reading, and code altering all without computers.
long_description: Children spend a focused week as Junior Coders. Day 1 introduces sequential code (C3.1). Day 2 introduces loops (C3.1). Day 3 reads existing code and predicts (C3.2). Day 4 alters code and predicts new outcomes (C3.2). Day 5 closes with child-invented code projects. Each lesson includes a 4000+ char expanded_walkthrough covering misconceptions: unordered-list, loop-as-list, direction-blind prediction, alteration-doesn't-matter persistence, loop omission.
what_is_included: 5 fully-scripted lesson plans with 50-minute durations and 250 minutes of total teaching time
5 student worksheets aligned to each lesson

10 printable teacher manipulatives plus 2 character puppets: coding grid mat, code step cards (30), existing code sample cards (12), robot marker template, loop cards (8), code writing template, predict-and-check chart, code alteration cards (8), capstone template, Loop the Loop poster, plus stick-puppet variants of Coda and Looper
1 end-of-unit reflection sheet with 5 self-assessment prompts
1 two-row summative rubric covering C3.1-C3.2 across 4 levels
1 summative-administration guide tying the rubric to Lesson 5 worksheet
Detailed expanded walkthroughs covering common misconceptions
Differentiation tracks built into every lesson
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 1 teachers covering the C3.1-C3.2 cluster — coding without screens.
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: CRA progression. The grid mat is the anchor — children execute code physically. Lesson 1 conceptualises sequence. Lesson 2 introduces loops. Lesson 3 reads code. Lesson 4 alters code. Lesson 5 closes with capstone. No screens needed; perfect for early-grade coding introduction.
